basis: Read by a person from aagento-bridge rcc-box-rule-engine.ts, rcc-box.defaults.ts, rcc-box-mapper.ts and the views that draw the same quantities. Units: the rule engine adds every geometry value to levels in metres (z_bot = bedLvl - wearC - tSB, line 40), so they are metres; a field divided by 1000 where it is drawn is millimetres.

project.cells.label: number of cells (barrels) across the box

geometry.clear_w.label: clear span of one cell (inner face to inner face)

geometry.clear_h.label: clear height of a cell (top of bottom slab to soffit of top slab)

geometry.t_wall_i.label: thickness of each intermediate (inner) wall between cells

geometry.haunch_size.label: haunch size (leg) at the wall–slab junctions

deck.wearing_course.label: wearing course on the bottom slab (bed level is its top)

hydraulics.bed_lvl.label: bed level: the finished floor, top of the wearing course

hydraulics.soffit_level.label: soffit level as entered (an input; the engine computes its own soffit)

deck.embankment_slope.label: embankment side slope, horizontal per vertical (SLOPE n:1)

deck.earth_cushion.label: earth cushion as entered (the engine computes its own from the levels)

foundation.pcc_sub_base.label: PCC sub-base thickness under the bottom slab

foundation.sand_fill_depth.label: sand / granular fill depth under the PCC

foundation.found_d.label: granular fill thickness as the half section draws it

options2d.show_wing_wall.label: wing walls are part of the arrangement

project.status.label: EXISTING or PROPOSED structure (an existing one reads ex_formation_lvl / ex_rail_level)

total_w.label: overall width of the box, outer face to outer face

total_h.label: overall height of the box, underside of bottom slab to top of top slab

flow_area.label: clear waterway area of all cells

z_bot.label: level of the underside of the bottom slab

z_top.label: level of the top of the top slab

soffit.label: level of the underside of the top slab (computed)

rccBoxTopLvl.label: level of the top of the box

pccTop.label: level of the top of the PCC sub-base

pccBot.label: level of the underside of the PCC sub-base

granBot.label: level of the underside of the sand / granular fill

formLvl.label: formation level used by the drawing

railLvl.label: rail level used by the drawing

earthCushion.label: earth cushion above the box (formation − top of box, not below 0)

disabled_rules.text: HFL below the inner roof (hfl − bed_lvl < clear_h)
HFL not above the soffit level
computed soffit (z_top − t_slab_t) within 10 mm of the entered soffit level
earth cushion ≥ 75 mm (IRS requirement, as the comment says)
slab not narrower than the box

findings.text: validate() of the registered railway RCC box engine is inside a block comment (lines 106–160): the production app runs no domain validation for this family; the rules above are knowledge, not enforced anywhere.

the half section draws the granular fill from foundation.found_d (fallback 0.85 m) while the rule engine's granBot uses foundation.sand_fill_depth (fallback 0.7 m): the two views can disagree about the foundation depth.
fallback defaults differ between the rule engine and the half section (t_slab_b 0.35 vs 0.400 m): with a field missing, the engine and the drawing use different values.
the family defaults enter hydraulics.soffit_level 99.648 while the engine computes soffit 99.498 from them: the (disabled) soffit consistency rule would warn on the defaults themselves.
